answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 42196 Country: India Title: At the time of wearing clothes or during drying the body with a towel after bath, my hands get touched with the private parts (unintentionally) Question: At the time of wearing clothes or during drying the body with a towel after bath, my hands get touched with the private parts (unintentionally). So in this case, does my ablution break? Answer ID: 42196 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1687/1687/M=1433) Wudhu does not break only due to touching the private part until nothing comes out of it which breaks the wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
